Because Polaris (the North Star) is at the tail of Ursa Minor, sailors used it as a guide star.

evolution.meaning: the constellation Ursa Minor; guide star
evolution.usage: Used in Roman celestial navigation.
Used in navigation and literature.
Extended in English literature (e.g., Milton's L'Allegro) from the literal North Star to anyone who is the focus of all eyes.
